authorship: Conversion code authored after existing targets and codec mathematics were already known; no blindness or new independent financial oracle claim.
comparison: Exact nested bracket, never overlap or epsilon. Public consumer must contain both reference endpoints; exact-rational point classification remains separate from required proof discovery.
not_performed: No log/exp recomputation or certificate verification
purpose: Lossless existing case transport plus minimum exact expected representation conversion for the committed M8 feature; not financial oracle generation.

representation_algorithms.binary64: Exact integer floor-log and quotient/remainder at unit max(floorlog(abs(q))-52,-1074); reverse directions for negative values; unavailable endpoint beyond finite MAX; canonical zero.
representation_algorithms.certified_interval: Copy original p/sign/m/K and retain full certificate ID; floor original lower and ceil original upper; never classify a merely enclosed point as exact.
representation_algorithms.decimal: Exhaust the 39 permitted scales with exact signed integer division; prefer the first fitting i128 coefficient, then exact finite Binary64, otherwise NoFittingPoint.
